facts.fact: The ITIE-Guinee steering committee's policy states that the Ministry of Mines (www.mines.gov.gn), CPDM, SOGUIPAMI, the Chambre des Mines and the central bank (BCRG) publish revenue data, including extractive revenues, on their own sites, and that mining contracts are online at www.contratsminiersguinee.com; no event date is given, so the document's 2017 date is used.
